title: onobrychis supina subsp. intermedia
intro: Onobrychis supina subsp. intermedia, commonly known as a type of sainfoin, is a plant species that belongs to the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating various gastrointestinal issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery. The therapeutic actions of Onobrychis supina subsp. intermedia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it useful for soothing digestive problems and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
